Claire — quick technical readout after reviewing the RFP:

Feasibility & timeline
- EU on-prem private environment: feasible. Typical lead time is 4–6 weeks from contract sign-off assuming network team can provide VPN endpoints, firewall rules, and DNS entries within 5 business days of kickoff.
- US air-gapped cluster: feasible but requires logistics for appliance shipment and acceptance testing — estimate 6–8 weeks.

Capacity & architecture
- For analytics peak: recommend 3 additional inference clusters (NVIDIA T4/GPU-equivalent), and 1 admin hot-spare cluster for zero-downtime maintenance. We’ll size exact vGPU/slot counts after you share expected QPS and token distribution; I noted the RFP calls for bursty nightly batches — please confirm peak hour QPS and batch sizes.
- Tenant isolation: we can provide full isolation per environment via separate Kubernetes namespaces, dedicated node pools, and network ACLs. For stronger separation we recommend isolated VPCs and distinct KMS/HSM key material per environment.

Requirements from AtlasPharma
- Network: VPN termination credentials, IP allow-lists, and routable subnets for management plane.
- Security: KMS/HSM access patterns and any on-prem key policies. If you need our HSM integration we’ll include instructions and an HSM connector in the SOW.
- Compliance artifacts: we’ll attach SOC2 mapping and a short runbook for audits.

I’ll prepare a tech appendix (SOW Annex A) detailing install steps and acceptance tests. Target delivery: Thu 6/4 EOD.
